configurations.name: v2
runtimeArgs: require('http').createServer((q,r)=>{const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');let u=q.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';let f=p.join('./v2',decodeURIComponent(u));if(!p.extname(f)&&fs.existsSync(f+'.html'))f=f+'.html';const e=p.extname(f),m={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json','.avif':'image/avif','.webp':'image/webp','.ico':'image/x-icon'};fs.readFile(f,(err,d)=>{if(err){r.writeHead(404);r.end('Not found: '+f)}else{r.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[e]||'text/plain'});r.end(d)}})}).listen(8090,()=>console.log('v2 server on port 8090'))
